# War Scroll Column 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 9 | **Condition:** complete

---

**1** The priests must not stain their robes with the blood of enemy dead; they are to keep their distance from the corpses.

**2** They must not approach the slain or risk contamination from impure blood, because they are consecrated, and they must not defile the sacred anointing oil of their priesthood with the blood of a godless nation.

**3** The high priest takes his stand, with his fellow priests, the Levites, and all the senior officers beside him, and from their station they pronounce a blessing on the God of Israel and all His faithful deeds.

**4** Then they pronounce a curse on the Devil and all the evil spirits who serve him, and they declare: "Praise the God of Israel for His holy plan and His faithful deeds!

**5** A curse on the Devil for his malicious schemes — may he be damned for his tyrannical rule! A curse on all the spirits who serve him for their wicked schemes!

**6** May they be damned for all their foul service! For they belong to the realm of darkness, but God's people belong to the realm of eternal light."

**7** Then the high priest rallies the troops and says to them: "Be brave and fight with courage as warriors of God!

**8** This is Israel's darkest hour and the appointed time for war against all the nations. God's people are destined for eternal salvation

**9** and for the total destruction of every evil nation. All godless peoples will cease to exist, and every wicked nation will be humiliated."

**10** "Remember what happened to Nadab and Abihu, Aaron's sons — God demonstrated His holiness by judging them before the entire people.

**11** But Eleazar and Ithamar He established in an everlasting priestly covenant. Take courage and do not be afraid!

**12** The enemy's ambitions are hollow and empty; their resources amount to nothing. They do not realize that from the God of Israel comes everything that exists and everything that will come to be.

**13** He will display His power in today's battle. He has refined you through the fire of suffering. He will raise the victory banner over the corpses of the wicked.

**14** Long ago He revealed to you through His awe-inspiring mysteries: 'A star will rise from Jacob, and a ruler will emerge from Israel.

**15** He will crush the leaders of Moab and destroy all the descendants of Seth. He will march from Jacob and wipe out every survivor from the enemy's city.'

**16** The enemy will become plunder, and Israel will triumph. Through Your chosen prophets, the ones who announced the appointed times, You revealed to us the schedule of Your holy wars.

**17** Our camp is sacred! Our army has the God of Israel on its side! The star will rise from Jacob, and the ruler will emerge from Israel!"

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 9 is well preserved. The priestly war liturgy blends blessing-curse formulas (drawing on Deut 27-28) with military exhortation. Lines 14-15 quote the Star Prophecy (Numbers 24:17-19), the most important messianic text at Qumran. "Belial" rendered as "the Devil"; "anointed ones, seers of appointed times" rendered as "chosen prophets who announced the appointed times" for clarity.*
